title: graphite daemon-health --json envelope (v1)
description: Response of `graphite daemon-health --json`: whether the daemon is maintaining the graphs it claims to be, and which projects are failing. ok:false carries errors. Top-level additional keys are allowed (additive evolution; additionalProperties:true is explicit because graphite's subset validator treats absence as closed); the keys listed as required here are the stable v1 surface. Note for consumers reusing graphite's subset validator (routing/schema_validation.py): it treats ABSENT additionalProperties as closed, so every deliberately open object in this file says additionalProperties:true explicitly.
